EICMA 2026 • Here Are Some of the Serious and Obscure Brands That EICMA 2026 Had To Offer – Worth Knowing About
Acura Back in F1 for 2026 Las Vegas GP, Replaces Honda Branding on New Aston Martin Livery
7 photos
Photo: Acura
This right here is a bit of a tradition, and it's nice to see it come back every once in a while when dealing with a Grand Prix on North American shores. It all starts with the Aston Martin F1 Team, which is set to run a special livery for the Las Vegas GP. Also new are the driver's race suits and helmets, which together with the livery will feature Acura branding instead of Honda.
So, during this race weekend alone, F1 fans will be able to see Acura logos in place of Honda logos on the cars' nose cone, engine cover and even the steering wheel (together with the previously-mentioned helmets and race suits). You'll also be able to see the Acura branding across the team's entire repertoire of racewear, meaning the cooling vests and underwear tops.
Don't get too excited, an underwear top is simply that fire-resistant, long-sleeved undershirt worn directly beneath the driver's outer race suit. It's got nothing to do with their underwear .
Now that we've gotten that vital piece of information out of the way, we should also mentioned that for the first time ever, Acura logos will be applied to F1 Academy suits, thus expanding the carmaker's presence beyond what the F1 drivers wear. Aside from all that Acura stuff, Aston Martin will run a special livery in Vegas, as previously stated, designed specifically for its partner CoreWeave - which is an AI Cloud platform.
For those who don't know, Acura's presence in F1 goes back more than three decades. For instance, from 1989 to 1992, Honda F1 drivers (including Senna and Prost) wore Acura-branded helmet visors at the Canadian Grand Prix and the U.S. Grand Prix. Meanwhile, Jenson Button and Rubens Barrichello both had Acura logos on their visors at the 2007 Canadian Grand Prix.
In 2021, Acura returned to Formula 1 for the U.S. Grand Prix in Austin, featuring branding on the rear wings of the Red Bull Racing Honda and Scuderia AlphaTauri Honda cars - this meant that Acura branding appeared on the driving suits and helmet visors of Max Verstappen, Sergio Perez, Pierre Gasly and Yuki Tsunoda. Max went on to win that race in dramatic fashion, points that proved crucial to him securing his first-ever F1 title.
Photo: Acura Currently, Aston Martin are second-to-last in the constructors' standings with a total of just 7 points - all courtesy of Fernando Alonso . He brought home 4 points in Malaysia, 2 points in the Netherlands, and 1 point in Monaco. So his best finish was P8 in Sepang, which is actually quite impressive given how disastrous this season has been for the team. More specifically for Honda, because they seriously underperformed in the engine department.
Initially, the entire car was overweight and lacked downforce, but those issues were eventually resolved (more or less). Hopefully they have better luck next year.
